summary: The anchored cube argument is valid in both the positive-rank and rank-zero cases: every admissible fiber halfspace captures at least half of the centered subcube, and antipodal pairing gives the required number of base lattice points. The specialization correctly derives the positive profile, total and parity masses, line-coset and halfspace bounds, the strict energy upper bound, and the anchored capacity lower bound; all displayed exact arithmetic is consistent with the stated formulas.
